description: This file defines the Extension class in Drupal, representing extension (module/theme) objects with methods for retrieving extension info, loading files, and serialization handling.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Represents a Drupal extension (module or theme), providing methods to access extension properties, load files, and handle serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Extension object with root path, type, pathname, and optional filename.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the extension type, e.g., 'module' or 'theme'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the machine name of the extension.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the relative directory path of the extension.

methods.name: getPathname
methods.description: Returns the relative path and filename of the extension's info file.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the extension's info file.

methods.name: getExtensionPathname
methods.description: Returns the relative path of the main extension file, if any.

methods.name: getExtensionFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the main extension file, if any.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Includes the main extension file if it exists.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Returns an SplFileInfo object for the extension's info file.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization, excluding non-serializable properties.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Restores the root property after unserialization, using container parameters.

methods.name: isExperimental
methods.description: Checks if the extension is marked as experimental.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks if the extension is marked as obsolete.
